<thought>To generate all possible slab terminations, I will call the enumerate_slabs_text tool, providing only the required bulk_cif argument (the CIF content with newline characters escaped). This uses the default Miller index (1,1,1) and default slab/vacuum sizes.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>
